title: 能力市场：PM 能否找到双边核心价值与核心功能（v3 spec 为基线）
task: stage: define, task: spec. The discovery briefing for this change is frozen (see inputs). Write the spec (01-define/spec.md, plus 01-define/tracking.md if new events are needed) for this change.
v3_gaps_observed: grep on baseline spec.md (2026-09-17): 核心价值 0 · Aha 0 · 旅程 0 · J-1 0 · 方案对比 0 matches
Tenant value is kept out of this round's acceptance exactly as the briefing decided (A3/K3; 未量化 ×7) — correct; but 假设 appears once and no hypothesis carries a validation time or fallback
The recorded solution forks S1–S4 are technical choices (scan channel, directory upload, drawer, markdown renderer), not product concepts
what_good_looks_like: Names who gets value on each side and where their Aha moment is; separates core-path features from support/governance work with a stated test; compares at least three genuinely different product concepts; writes walkable journeys that requirements hang off; turns low-evidence value into testable hypotheses with metrics instead of excluding it; keeps requirements testable and measurable.

rubric.criterion: Identifies the core value path and Aha moment for each role that gets value. Where the briefing keeps a side out of this round's acceptance (A3/K3), the spec respects that decision and still names that side's value and Aha as a hypothesis — neither dropped nor written into acceptance
Separates core features from support/governance features with an explicit test and prioritizes accordingly
Compares at least three genuinely different product solution concepts with trade-offs
Key journeys are concrete and walkable; requirements anchor to journey steps

Low-evidence value becomes a testable hypothesis with a metric, a validation time and a fallback, while respecting the briefing's decisions (K3: no consumer metric in acceptance without count data) — not silently excluded, not faked, not smuggled into acceptance
Requirements are testable (GWT) and measurable (north star, drivers, guardrails, events)
